title: Cascara Dark & Stormy
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine the lime juice and ginger beer in an Old Fashioned glass over ice and stir to combine. Float the cascara concentrate on top of the mixture and garnish.

Cascara Tea ConcentrateSteep 25 grams of cascara in approximately 9 oz. of hot water for 12 minutes. Strain the husks out of the liquid and let cool. At Onyx, they use Panama Los Lajones Gesha cascara for the mix. You can buy a bag on their website.
